workout.warmup: 8-10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%) - non-negotiable on lower day, this is your back warmup not just cardio. Then bodyweight squats x 15 and leg swings before you touch the bar. Ramp the Smith squat: bar only x 8, then 2x45 (135) x 5, then work.
workout.finisher: Skip if you're at 65 min. Otherwise 10 min incline walk.
workout.coach_note: You hit 175 for a clean 4x5 on the bench yesterday - that's the set 4 you'd missed twice. 175 is graduated, we go to 185 next upper day. Today: you've never actually completed 4 full sets at 185 on either Smith lift. Jul 20 you got squat 205x5 then 185 for 6 and 5, and RDL 185 for 6/6 (only 3 sets total). Today is about finishing the job at 185 on both - four clean sets, then both lifts move up next week. Back is clear so the RDL is unrestricted, but STRAPS ON, no exceptions - that's what fixed the grip and kept the hinge safe. Two logging notes: your Jul 24 lower session never made it into the app, so I'm programming off Jul 20 - if you went heavier Friday, adjust up and tell me after. And yesterday's shoulder press note says you started at 50 and then dropped to 50, so I can't tell if the top set was 50 or 55 - clarify when you get a minute.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat [HEAVY]
exercises.note: Finish all four sets at 185 - you got 6 then 5 last time and stopped. Below parallel like you did Jul 20, that depth was good. If sets 1 and 2 fly, put 205 on for sets 3 and 4. If the Smith rack is taken, sub Leg Press at 360-390 for 4 x 6-8 and we flip the rotation next lower day.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift [HEAVY]
exercises.note: Ramp at 165 x 6 first, then 185 for four sets. You did 6/6 at 185 last time and it was clean - the hamstrings were doing the work, which is exactly right. Straps are mandatory here, they're what solved the grip and took the strain off your upper back. Hinge from the hips, soft knee, bar close to the legs. Complete 4x6 and you go to 195 next lower day.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Third session in a row this is on the sheet and you've been shut out by taken machines twice. Hamstrings are your weak link - if the seated machine is occupied, use the lying leg curl, and if both are gone do stability-ball leg curls for 3 x 12. Don't skip it a third time. Slow on the way back down.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.note: Bringing glutes back in - you haven't hit these in a while and they've been missing from the block. Plate-loaded, 10 lb increments only. Full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top, and no hyperextension at lockout. If the machine is taken, sub DB walking lunge at 35 lb for 3 x 10/leg.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Pallof Press 40 lb x 10/side, Bird Dog x 8/side, Hanging Knee Raise x 10
exercises.note: Rotated off yesterday's cable crunch / dead bug / side plank. All three are back-safe after two heavy hinge-pattern lifts. Pause a full second at the top of the bird dog. Cut to 1 round if you're past 65 min.
